kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تعتقلون (form VIII)
# تَعْتَقِلُونَ (taʕtaqilūna) /taʕ.ta.qi.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
# تُعْتَقَلُونَ (tuʕtaqalūna) /tuʕ.ta.qa.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
